a1_arcroles.col1: Appraisal Report: Appraiser Performing the Subject Property Inspection
a1_arcroles.col2: Provide one RELATIONSHIP container for the appraiser role (provided in the data set) joining the INSPECTION container to the PARTY container.

a1_arcroles.col2: When the subject property has a living unit included in the rent schedule, the RENTAL_INFORMATION container from the comparable should be linked (via Arc Role) to the subject's instance of the RENTAL_INFORMATION container to which it was compared.
